explanation: The intended Green's theorem calculation gives curl −x²−y², hence −∫₀²π∫₂⁴ r³ dr dθ = −120π (option a). However, ln(sin² y) is undefined where y is a multiple of π, including points on the boundary. Thus the ordinary line integral is not defined as stated; −120π is the formal result and also the value under an improper-integral interpretation.
